label: Attribution versus patching, adjudicated against planted ground truth
limitation: It does not establish that the same holds on another subject, another dataset or another run.
scope: One frozen study, adjudicated once, on skywork-v2-qwen3-0.6b and skywork-v02, over adjavp-organism and rb2-patch-40.
statement: The frozen study "Attribution versus patching, adjudicated against planted ground truth" was adjudicated refuted, over 1 registered predictions of which 1 did not. the two instruments are statistically tied against the marker-response key on the organism; neither localization can be preferred, undercutting every attribution-based number (a noisy key, visible in the emitted margin distribution, is the disclosed alternative reading).
